entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I have an order and I... I think I need to send something back. I'm not sure how it works. It's all very confusing on the website.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your name and order number, please?
Yes, my name is Sarah Miller. The order number is... V F 7 8 9 0 1. I think. It's for a jersey.

Okay, thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the VeloFit Performance Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... it's the wrong size. It's way too tight on me, and I can't really wear it. I thought I ordered the right one, but maybe I read the chart wrong. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a different size. Let me just check your purchase details.
An exchange would be great, yes. I just want one that fits. I hope it's not too late.
Okay, I see here that the jersey was delivered 62 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy. One moment.
Oh no, has it been that long? I've been so busy, I completely forgot about it.
No problem at all, Sarah. According to our policy for standard items like this jersey, you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return or exchange. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can still send it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange process for you in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the original jersey back to us. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the next size up for you.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex! You've made this so easy. I was really worried.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
